summary: Full backend + frontend test of controlled IA update (DT flagship, Team Augmentation submenu with separate pages, Insights split into Articles/Case Studies/Blog, DT-only hero video). 10/10 backend pytest cases pass. All requested frontend flows work on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844.
action_items: MINOR (naming only, non-blocking): review request expected the contact email input at data-testid='contact-email', but the app uses 'contact-email-input' (data-testid='contact-email' is bound to the mailto link on the same page). Consider renaming the mailto link (e.g. 'contact-email-link') and renaming the input to 'contact-email' to match the spec, or update the spec. Frontend submission works end-to-end regardless.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @api_router.on_event('startup') for seeding — deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider lifespan handler. Non-blocking.
POST /api/contact fires email via loop.run_in_executor without awaiting; failures are logged but not surfaced. Acceptable for MVP.
Insight model returns created_at as datetime while stored as ISO string — the _serialize_insight converts before response_model validation; OK.
seed_data_creation: None created manually. Startup seed populated 3 articles + 3 blog posts as expected. Test contact enquiries created with TEST_ prefix (TEST_Playwright User, TEST_UI) — non-destructive, kept for audit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Key testids verified: nav-services, nav-solutions, nav-team-augmentation, nav-products, nav-industries, nav-insights, nav-about, header-cta ('Talk to an Expert'), region-selector + region-option-ae (label changes India->UAE & GCC), nav-services-flagship (Digital Transformation, columns SAP/Oracle/Salesforce/Build & Cloud; Build & Cloud = Software Development, Artificial Intelligence, RPA, Cyber Security only — no DT/TA). TA pages: team-augmentation-page (positioning 'Ready-to-deploy certified…', Hire Consultants & Talk to an Expert CTAs, Onsite/Offshore/Hybrid, PAN India/Gulf/UAE/Dubai), ta-by-skill-page, ta-by-delivery-page, ta-by-geography-page. No console/page errors observed on Home, DT, TA, Insights, Blog, Case Studies, Contact.
